default.title: Obtain the Sinner
default.text: Forensica, forensic pathologist. Let me be clear from the start—I have zero patience for the living.

default.title: Raise to Phase 1
default.text: One step closer... to the truth...

default.title: Raise to Phase 3
default.text: You won't escape... this time.

default.title: Level Start
default.text: The investigation begins.

default.title: Victory
default.text: Work's done. Time to file the report.

default.title: Lose Battles
default.text: This makes no sense... what did I miss...?

default.title: Ultimate Skill
default.text: In the name of the dead!

default.title: Die in Battles
default.text: My body... will reveal... the truth...

default.title: Greeting
default.text: You're here. Any new cases today? I'm heading back if there's nothing to do.

default.title: Conversation 1
default.text: I like staying in the autopsy room. Corpses are far more pleasant to look at than all those idiots wandering around here.

default.title: Conversation 2
default.text: Another complaint about me from the new assistant? What did I do? I only told her, "Don't beat yourself up for messing up. This is not the first time anyway." I was trying to comfort her. ...Um, what? Is there a problem?

default.title: Conversation 3
default.text: A forensic pathologist's job is more than just autopsies—it's also crime scene investigation. From contaminating evidence and tampering with scenes, to influencing conclusions... those with ulterior motives can interfere from the very start. You're doing a good job keeping this place clean. For now, at least.

default.title: Special Conversation 1
default.text: Terrible personality? Harsh words? Hard to work with? I'm here to work, not to babysit my coworkers. They could learn a thing or two from corpses—at least the dead don't complain this much.

default.title: Special Conversation 2
default.text: Corpses decay, but the patience of the living is even more fleeting. If you can't find the truth in time, you're stuck with living out the rest of your days with no answers. That's... what it means to be a forensic pathologist.

default.title: Special Conversation 3
default.text: The dead are always the most vulnerable in this world—they're dismissed by society and abandoned by their families. Sometimes... I'm the only voice they have left.

default.title: Full Compliance
default.text: Corpses never lie. It's always the living who do. I'm not staying here because I've regained faith in what the living call justice... I'm staying because I trust you. I trust you'll give me the chance to speak the truth in their stead.

default.title: Idle
default.text: Dorothy, the cutest little bone in the whole world... Hmm, you're getting a bit fuzzy here. Let me fix that for you...

default.title: Annoyed
default.text: Stop poking around. These are autopsy tools. You won't be needing them.

default.title: Special Attention
default.text: Why do you keep staring at me? Is there something on my face? You're distracting me from my thoughts...

default.title: Dispatch
default.text: What a pain... Can't I just go alone?

default.title: Dispatch Complete
default.text: Got you the things you wanted. You promised to give me three days off. Leave me alone while I'm away. I'm not seeing anyone.

default.title: Level Up
default.text: Forensic science advances, and so do I.
